content: WCAG disabled state exception: SC 1.4.3 explicitly exempts 'inactive UI components' from contrast requirements. However, 'dimmed but interactive' elements (respond to clicks) may not qualify as inactive. M3 pattern: disabled text uses 38% opacity of on-surface color, disabled containers use 12% opacity. Current textDisabled #444455 at 2.14:1 matches M3 disabled ratio (2.34:1). Key distinction: visually absent vs visually dimmed but functional.
